propositions: llm_calls and latency metrics must be summed from REVIEW_RESULT.metrics only, never from COMPLETION_VERDICT which carries no metrics block
cost_per_accepted_change is derived by dividing total llm_calls by count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records, returning None when zero accepted closes exist
first_pass_verification measures the fraction of tickets whose earliest COMPLETION_VERDICT record (by chronological filename order) is a completion_verifier_pass_v1

env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 ERROR record with the next PASS record on the same gate (matching gate field), computing the timestamp delta as the interval duration, leaving unmatched ERRORs as open intervals
sidecar reader performs a single raw ordered scan of each ticket's *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json event files without using reducer-aware schema-guarded helpers
